text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 90 units of fluoxetine hydrochloride 20 mg capsules with 10.4 days on hand. Corvale General holds 221.15 units with 28.1 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list fluoxetine hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both sites. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Supply continuity depends on securing additional purchase commitments.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with A-S Medication Solutions, Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee LLC, Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, and American Health Packaging to replenish stock; buyer approves.
2. Buyer confirms delivery schedules and allocates received units to Corvale East first; buyer approves.
3. Pharmacy director reviews procurement plan and authorizes expenditure; pharmacy director approves.
4. P&T committee acknowledges the supply plan at its next meeting; P&T committee chair approves.

Not recommended: Initiating therapeutic alternatives or formulary changes based on current inventory levels.
